contexts.text: If scientific truths disappear through fallacies from sensuous things. Signified.
By this is signified the disappearance of truths through fallacies from sensuous things.
When they dissent, they disappear from the eyes of those who dissent. HH 194.
Wherefore, if the ultimates are parted, the interiors also are dissipated.
In proportion as anyone acts and speaks against his love, his face begins... not to appear, and at last he totally disappears, as if he had not been there. DLW 369.
After a brief stay there, he disappears.
As soon as they were gone, these shapes disappeared.
As soon as a Spirit disagrees in opinion with another, he disappears.
When Spirits who are not yet vastated turn towards them... they as it were disappear from sight...
